---
title: "Publications"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig.keep: none
#| dev: ragg_png

# Read bibliography
bib <- RefManageR::ReadBib(
  file = "publications.bib",
  check = FALSE
)

if (length(bib) == 0) {
  cat("<p>No publications found.</p>\n")
  return(invisible(NULL))
}

# Helper to coerce a value to a non-empty character string
ensure_char <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) "" else as.character(x)
}

# Extract fields into a tibble
n <- length(bib)
pub_list <- vector(mode = "list", length = n)

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  entry <- bib[i]
  title <- ensure_char(entry$title)
  journal <- ensure_char(entry$journal)
  year <- ensure_char(entry$year)
  doi <- ensure_char(entry$doi)
  url <- ensure_char(entry$url)
  key <- names(bib)[[i]]

  # Format authors
  authors_raw <- tryCatch(
    expr = entry$author,
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (
    length(authors_raw) > 0 &&
    inherits(x = authors_raw, what = "person")
  ) {
    author_formatted <- stringr::str_c(
      format(
        x = authors_raw,
        include = c("family", "given")
      ),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  } else {
    author_formatted <- ""
  }

  pub_list[[i]] <- list(
    key = key,
    title = title,
    authors = author_formatted,
    journal = journal,
    year = year,
    doi = doi,
    url = url
  )
}

pub_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(pub_list) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(x = year))

years <- unique(pub_tbl[["year"]])

# Emit HTML for each year group
for (yr in years) {
  cat(
    '<h2 class="pub-year">', yr, '</h2>\n',
    sep = ""
  )

  yr_pubs <- dplyr::filter(
    .data = pub_tbl,
    year == yr
  )

  for (row_idx in seq_len(nrow(yr_pubs))) {
    row <- yr_pubs[row_idx, ]

    title_html <- if (
      nchar(row[["doi"]]) > 0
    ) {
      doi_url <- stringr::str_c("https://doi.org/", row[["doi"]])
      stringr::str_c(
        '<a href="', doi_url, '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">',
        htmltools::htmlEscape(text = row[["title"]]),
        '</a>'
      )
    } else if (nchar(row[["url"]]) > 0) {
      stringr::str_c(
        '<a href="', row[["url"]], '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">',
        htmltools::htmlEscape(text = row[["title"]]),
        '</a>'
      )
    } else {
      htmltools::htmlEscape(text = row[["title"]])
    }

    authors_html <- htmltools::htmlEscape(text = row[["authors"]])

    venue_html <- stringr::str_c(
      "<em>",
      htmltools::htmlEscape(text = row[["journal"]]),
      "</em>"
    )

    if (nchar(row[["year"]]) > 0) {
      venue_html <- stringr::str_c(
        venue_html, ", ",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(text = row[["year"]])
      )
    }

    # Build links
    links_parts <- character(0)
    if (nchar(row[["doi"]]) > 0) {
      links_parts <- c(
        links_parts,
        stringr::str_c(
          '<a class="badge" href="https://doi.org/',
          row[["doi"]],
          '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DOI</a>'
        )
      )
    }
    if (nchar(row[["url"]]) > 0) {
      links_parts <- c(
        links_parts,
        stringr::str_c(
          '<a class="badge" href="',
          row[["url"]],
          '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">URL</a>'
        )
      )
    }

    links_html <- if (length(links_parts) > 0) {
      stringr::str_c(
        '<div class="pub-links">',
        stringr::str_c(links_parts, collapse = " "),
        '</div>'
      )
    } else {
      ""
    }

    # Build card
    cat(
      '<div class="pub-card">\n',
      '  <div class="pub-title">', title_html, '</div>\n',
      '  <div class="pub-authors">', authors_html, '</div>\n',
      '  <div class="pub-venue">', venue_html, '</div>\n',
      '  ', links_html, '\n',
      '</div>\n',
      sep = ""
    )
  }
}
```
